card.name: Academic department names before the field
card.fires_on: Words inside a university department name, such as 'of', 'and' or an adjective, right before the academic field is named. It appears in author affiliations in news and research text.

modes.label: 'of' after department
modes.description: The word 'of' directly after 'department' or 'departments' in an affiliation.
modes.example: chair of the department<< of>> community and behavioral health at the Colorado School

modes.label: Inside a multi-word field
modes.description: A linking word or modifier partway through a department's field name.
modes.example: professor of African American<< and>> gender studies, learned that, like Henry

card.writes: It pushes the model toward academic field names such as physics, psychology, sociology and physiology.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a university affiliation where the name of the academic field is about to come.
